Good morning Mr. Al Jamalullayel,
I am reaching out as Sicharge D Expert from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0459889.
Apologies for the late reply.
Last week, between Thursday and Friday I managed to launch the 5 consecutive updates (v3>v4>v5>v6>v7>v8), in order to bring the charger to the latest and best FW version,
v8.0.5.
Please let me know if further support is required for this ticket. I will proceed to close the ticket once your feedback is received.
